name: 侠客行一百
english_description: By Coollizard & xkx100, 2003-2004, hosted at yoyo.xm.fj.cn/xkx100 — a completely different codebase from the separately built GitHub fluffos/xkx100 repository that merely happens to share the same name. Its map is among the largest of its kind, stretching from central-China cities like Chang'an, Luoyang, Dali, and Xiangyang out to frontier and overseas settings such as the northern steppes, Kazakhstan, and Taiwan, covering nearly the full geography of ancient China. Character creation is unusually detailed for the genre, letting players choose a birthplace from five options, freely allocate attribute points, and pick from a menu of personality traits.
